verdict.rationale: A web-access API for agents could reasonably ship scheduled monitors or background automations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only on-demand calls: search, extract, crawl, map and research. The closest feature is a research task whose status can be retrieved by request ID, which is a one-off asynchronous job, not a user-configured recurring automation, and no scheduling, triggers or monitors are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
